reason: I have one or two chairs and I am standing at one of them all day, so I already see who is in which chair and I count the drawer myself every night. Paying ₹999 a month plus ₹4,999 to watch a shop I am already standing in does not make sense for me.
objection: My boy is busy with customers, he won't type every walk-in's number and bill into an app, and I won't either with scissors in my hand. Half of it is for bigger salons with staff I need to keep an eye on.
would_change_my_mind: If it was only the customer side, the WhatsApp reminders, wallet and referral, for around ₹299-399 a month with no setup fee, and someone showed me it actually brings old customers back.
